spans.s:
उज्जि उज्-जि (उद्-जि), cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्,
to win, conquer, acquire by conquest; to be victorious:
Caus. -जापयति, -यितुम्, to assist any one to win;
to cause to conquer (with two acc.): Desid. -जिगीषति,
to wish to conquer.

उज्-जिति, इस्, f., Ved. victory; N. of certain verses in
the Vājasaneyi-Saṃhitā, so called because the words
उदजयत् तम् उज्जेषम् occurs in them.
उज्जिहान उज्जिहान, N. of a region.

उज्जिहीर्षा उज्-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt.
हृ with उद्), wishing to take or seize.

उज्जीव् उज्-जीव् (उद्-जीव्), cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वि-
तुम्, to revive, return to life: Caus. P. -जीवयति,
-यितुम्, to restore to life, animate.

उज्-जीविन्, ई, m., N. of a counsellor of Meghavarṇa,
the king of the crows.
